meta.title: Q&A
meta.description: Answers to common questions about voting in Sotik and the campaign.

title: Questions, answered.
intro: Facts about voting in Sotik, each with its source. Questions for Robert himself can be sent from the Contact page.

when.q: When is the next General Election?
when.a: Tuesday 10 August 2027. IEBC published the notice on 14 September 2026.

campaign.a: The IEBC campaign period runs from 29 May to 7 August 2027, ending 48 hours before polling day.

voters.q: How many registered voters does Sotik have?
voters.a: 86,681, according to the IEBC register for the 2022 General Election.

wards.a: Five: Kapletundo, Chemagel, Kipsonoi, Ndanai/Abosi and Rongena/Manaret.

register.q: How do I check that I am registered?
register.a: Use IEBC's official voter verification services, or visit your IEBC constituency office in Sotik.
